description: Pager for a known total: renders nothing for a single page and collapses long ranges with gaps. LoadMore is the one for a list with no total. Copy: the accessible name says WHICH collection is paged — "Invoices pages", not "Pagination". A screen with two paged lists is otherwise two identical controls.

props.name: siblingCount
props.description: How many numbered buttons to show around the current page. Default 1 (so: first … prev-cur-next … last).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible names — the control is a labelled navigation landmark.

example: const [page, setPage] = useState(3)<Pagination page={page} pageCount={12} onChange={setPage} />
